chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran and Ibn Fazzal, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
He used to say during an illness.
O Allah! You have criticized certain people, saying: 'Say: Call upon those whom you claim (to be gods) besides Him, so they will not have the power to remove the distress from you nor to change it.'
So, O the One besides Whom no one else has the power to remove my distress or change it,
Send blessings upon Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad,
Remove my distress and transfer it to those who call upon another god alongside You.
There is no god other than You.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the supplication for illness that asks to transfer distress to those who call upon other gods?
ai.summary: This supplication, recorded in al-Kafi, exemplifies the Shia tradition of 'tawassul' through the attributes of God, specifically invoking the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt as a means to seek relief from illness. It creatively adapts the Quranic critique of false deities in Surah Al-Isra to transfer the supplicant's specific distress to those who worship idols, thereby affirming God's exclusive power to remove harm. This practice highlights the theological principle that while God is the ultimate source of healing, the Prophet and Imams serve as intercessors and channels of divine grace.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Adul Rahman Bin Abu Najran and Ibn Fazzal, from one of our companions,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abduallah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> used to say during an illness:

‘O Allahazwj! Youazwj have criticised certain nations saying: so Youazwj Said [17:56] Say: Call on those whom you assume (to be gods) besides Him, so they shall not control the removal of distress from you nor change it.
So, O the One besides Whom one can control the Removal of my distress nor change it, apart from Him<sup>azwj</sup>!
Send Salawāt upon Muhammadsaww and the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww
and Remove my distress and Change it to the ones who are calling to a god along with You<sup>azwj</sup>.
There is no god other than You<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn abu Najran and ibn Faddal from certain individuals of our people from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
For an ailment the Imam (a.s.) would say, ‘
O Lord, You have criticized certain nations saying, “(Muhammad), tell them, ‘Seek help from those whom you consider equal to Allah. They are not able to remove or change your hardships’” [17:56]
O the One besides whom no one is able to provide me relief or divert the hardships away from me,
confer al-Salat (favors) upon Muhammad and his family,
grant me relief and divert the suffering from me to those who worship things other than You.’
